title: Anderson Mill Road Land Annexation Hearing
summary:
*   A special public meeting focused on a hearing for the potential full annexation of approximately 183 acres in the Anderson Mill Road area.
*   City officials from various departments, including transportation, solid waste, water, and public works, provided details and answered questions about the proposed annexation.
*   The public hearing on the Anderson Mill Road annexation plan was formally closed by a unanimous 6-0 vote.
transcript:
MINUTES OF CITY COUNCIL MEETING 
AUGUST 5,2002
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
MONDAY, AUGUST 5,2002
The City Council of Austin, Texas, convened in a Special Called Meeting on Monday,
August 5, 2002 at the Hope Presbyterian Church, located at 11512 Olson Drive, Austin,
Texas.
Mayor Garcia called the meeting to order at 6:32 p.m.
Public hearing on full purpose annexation of the Anderson Mill Road municipal
annexation plan area (approximately 183 acres located on Anderson Mill Road
approximately two-thirds of a mile east of the intersection of FM 620 and Anderson Mill
Road).
The presentation was made by Lisa Gordon, Assistant City Manager and; Ben
Luckens, Transportation, Planning and Sustainability.
The other city officials participating in the question and answer session were Willie
Rhodes, Solid Waste Services; Mike Boyle, Water and Wastewater Department; and
Ed Poppitt, Public Works (Street and Bridge Division.)
The public hearing was closed on Council Member Slusher's motion, Council
Member Wynn's second by a 6-0 vote. Council Member Thomas was absent.
The meeting was adjourned on Council Member Slusher's, Mayor Pro Tern
Goodman's second by 6-0 vote. Council Member Thomas was absent.
